pairs.why: Shows specialized Hodge classes of abelian varieties are represented by rational algebraic cycles, a rationality statement tied to the Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties.
Concerns algebraic cycles compatible across prime-to-p and crystalline realizations, close to Tate-type statements.
Rationality and independence of cohomology theory of intersection numbers of algebraic cycles is in the spirit of the standard conjectures.
Proves the full BSD leading-term formula for all elliptic curves over Q with Selmer corank at most one at some prime.
Congruent-number and sum-of-two-cubes type questions are BSD corollaries; the family proves rank-one results for X^3+Y^3=lZ^3.
Proves a zero-free half-plane Re s>7/8 for zeta, a partial result toward RH (quasi-RH).
Zero-free half-plane for all Dirichlet L-functions.
Zero-free half-plane for Hecke L-functions over Q(sqrt-3) and Dirichlet L-functions.
Proves uniform exclusion of Landau-Siegel zeros.
Zero-free region results bear on zero-density estimates.
Zero-free region strongly related to growth of zeta and Lindelof.
Proves Hilbert's tenth problem is undecidable over Q.
Companion result on 2-converse: Selmer corank at most one gives equal analytic and Mordell-Weil rank and finite Sha.
Proves Catalan's constant is irrational, one of the constants listed.
Goldfeld density and rank statistics for quadratic twists with a low-corank Selmer converse, tied to BSD-type rank questions.
Rank distribution of quadratic twists (e.g. of y^2=x^3-x) bears on which numbers are congruent.
Proves the odd regular two-dimensional Fontaine-Mazur conjecture over Q at the prime 2.
Proves Erdős's conjecture that some totient values have more than n^(1-ε) preimages, a statement about multiplicities of Euler's totient values, which Carmichael's conjecture also concerns.
Ostmann's inverse Goldbach conjecture on additive indecomposability of the primes is a related variant of Goldbach-type questions.
Ostmann's inverse Goldbach problem is a close variant of Goldbach's conjecture.
Proves generalized Ramanujan (temperedness) for globally generic cuspidal representations of split adjoint groups over function fields.
Constructs global Arthur enhancements of cuspidal parameters and Arthur-type decompositions by nilpotent orbits over function fields.
Uses measure rigidity for diagonal actions on the space of lattices to prove equidistribution of periodic torus orbits, related to Margulis-type measure classification.
Proves the abelian Zilber–Pink conjecture over Q-bar and the curve case in A2.
Shows irrationality exponent of π is 2, which implies convergence of the Flint Hills series.
Determines the irrationality measure of π, a constant of the kind this entry asks about.
Margulis–Platonov normal subgroup conjecture is a different Margulis conjecture, worth checking against this list entry.
Proves the local p-adic section conjecture and the global one over Q for X_0(N), X_1(N).
Squarefree values of irreducible integer polynomials is a sieve-type analogue of the prime-values question of Bunyakovsky.
Metric Diophantine approximation result (Duffin–Schaeffer type) in the same area as the Littlewood conjecture, though a different problem; worth a look.
Studies the distribution of values of Euler's totient function, which bears on questions about totient value multiplicities.
Short Egyptian fraction representations of a/b as sums of unit fractions, related to the Erdős–Straus unit-fraction question.
Egyptian fraction expansions of rationals; different question (greedy expansions) but same topic.
Concerns the distribution of prime gaps, showing a positive proportion of large gaps.
Claims to prove the Gaussian moat conjecture: no infinite bounded-step walk through Gaussian primes.
Proves infinitely many primes with primitive root a for every non-square a ≠ −1.
Same statement: infinitely many primes with a as a primitive root for a non-square, not −1.
Uchida's conjecture is an anabelian statement about Galois groups of number fields, in the same circle of ideas as the section conjecture.
Proves the rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties and for several other families of abelian varieties and K3 powers.
Obtains the Tate conjecture for abelian varieties over finite fields via Milne's theorems.
Obtains the Hodge standard conjecture for abelian varieties in every characteristic.
Proves log abundance (nef log canonical adjoint is semiample) in characteristic zero and for compact Kähler spaces, and related nonvanishing.
Proves the numerical-dimension-one case of (log) abundance for threefolds in characteristic p > 3.
Proves generalized abundance (numerical semiampleness) and minimal-model results for generalized pairs, and the numerical-dimension-one minimal model case.
Proves Fujita's freeness conjecture: K_X + mL is globally generated for m ≥ n+1.
Proves Nagata's strict inequality for plane curves through r ≥ 10 very general points.
Proves maximal multipoint Seshadri constants for large r on arbitrary polarized surfaces, and in higher dimensions.
Proves semiampleness of nef isotropic line bundles on hyperkähler manifolds, an abundance-type statement for nef bundles.
Constructs a singular normal affine complex surface with free tangent sheaf, a counterexample to Lipman–Zariski in characteristic zero.
Nakai's conjecture implies Zariski–Lipman, so a free-tangent-sheaf singular surface is relevant to it.
Shows canonical bundle ampleness for hyperbolic compact Kähler manifolds, adjacent to abundance-type positivity of the canonical bundle.
Proves termination of flip sequences in dimension four (Kähler and projective log canonical fourfolds), bearing on whether infinite flip sequences exist in dimension greater than 3.
Constructs ambiently homeomorphic reduced hypersurface germs with different multiplicities, a counterexample to Zariski's multiplicity conjecture.
The generalized Mukai conjecture characterizes projective space via Fano pseudoindex and extends Mori's solution of Hartshorne's conjecture, so it is worth a look.
Topological triviality of mu-constant families of surface singularities is the surface case of the Lê–Ramanujam problem, closely tied to topological equisingularity and equimultiplicity.
Proves the Virasoro conjecture for smooth projective complete intersections and projective bundle towers in all genera and curve classes.
Campana–Peternell is a generalization of Hartshorne's ample tangent bundle conjecture (Mori's theorem) to nef tangent bundle; proved here in dimension six.
Anticanonical nonvanishing under semipositivity is a nonvanishing statement in the circle of effective nonvanishing and abundance-type conjectures.
Proves Brennan's conjecture on area integrability of |phi'|^s for 4/3<s<4.
Proves that compact sets in R^d of Hausdorff dimension greater than d/2 have distance sets of positive Lebesgue measure for all d>=2.
Proves the Kakeya maximal conjecture in R^3 and Hausdorff-dimension Kakeya in R^4, settling the dimension-3 and dimension-4 cases.
Proves the symmetric (and nonsymmetric) Mahler volume-product conjectures in every dimension with Hanner polytope equality cases.
Proves bounded-distortion L_1 embeddings for planar and bounded-treewidth graph metrics, the planar and treewidth cases of the GNRS conjecture.
Proves the Brauchart–Hardin–Saff conjecture on the linear term of optimal logarithmic energy on the 2-sphere, a Thomson-type minimal energy question.
Proves planar Cohn–Elkies sharpness, with the Fourier certificate attaining the optimal circle-packing density in dimension 2.
Proves a cubic lower bound on border determinantal complexity of the permanent, progress on Valiant's algebraic VP versus VNP analogue of P versus NP.
Explicit depth-three circuit lower bound beyond 2^sqrt(n) for a polynomial-time language, a restricted-model step toward circuit lower bounds separating P from NP.
Shows Goemans–Linial SDP integrality gaps for uniform sparsest cut, which concern l1 embeddability of metrics with bounded distortion, the area the GNRS conjecture lives in.

Proves every regular language has generalized star height at most three (and earlier bounds 13 and 4), a uniform bound on the generalized star height; the problem of whether it is always 1 remains, so this settles the boundedness question.
The factorization algorithm relies on a companion paper on primitive roots for admissible integer bases, so the family may touch Artin's primitive root conjecture.
Depends on a companion result about primitive roots for every admissible base, close to the question of infinitely many primes with a given primitive root.
Proves uniform boundedness of limit cycles of planar polynomial vector fields by degree (the second part of Hilbert's sixteenth problem) and gives the exact bound of two for quintic Liénard systems.
Constructs a smooth volume-preserving diffeomorphism of the three-torus with simple Lebesgue spectrum, answering Banach's problem in the probability-preserving setting.
Proves every invertible mixing transformation is mixing of all finite orders, answering Rokhlin's multiple mixing problem.
Proves the near-boundary version of the Birkhoff conjecture: foliated collar of caustics/invariant curves forces an ellipse.
Pointwise convergence of multiple ergodic averages for mixing systems is closely tied to multiple mixing, a related variant of the 3-mixing question.
Builds a translational tile of Z^3 and R^3 that tiles only aperiodically, a three-dimensional analogue of the aperiodic monotile question.
Periodic tiling conjecture counterexample is closely tied to tiling/spectral set questions in Fuglede's conjecture.
Gives a set in R^9 needing more than ten smaller-diameter pieces, lowering the dimension of the known Borsuk counterexample.
Disproves Hadwiger's conjecture with graphs of independence number two, even fractionally.
Proves a linear list-coloring bound in terms of Hadwiger number (list Hadwiger), a list-coloring variant though not the edge version.
Shows the plane's chromatic number is at least 6.
Proves Erdős's conjecture that divergent reciprocal sums give arbitrarily long APs.
Proves quasipolynomial upper bounds for r_k(N).
Gives superexponential lower bounds for van der Waerden numbers W_r(k).
Disproves Sidorenko's conjecture with an explicit 35-vertex bipartite graph.
Constructs counterexamples to Ryser's covering conjecture in the intersecting case.
Proves the Zarankiewicz formula for crossing numbers of complete bipartite graphs.
Zarankiewicz crossing-number conjecture shares the name; a different problem but worth a look.
Determines crossing numbers of complete graphs, which the Albertson conjecture uses as its lower bound.
Distinct-distance bounds in R^d are the discrete analogue of Falconer's distance-set conjecture.
Proves a power saving O(n^beta), beta<4/3, for planar unit distances.
Pinned distinct-distance results are a discrete analogue of the Falconer distance-set problem.
Combinatorial invariance of Kazhdan–Lusztig polynomials concerns the same polynomials, though it is a separate conjecture.
Determines the asymptotic exponent of off-diagonal Ramsey numbers r(s,t) for s>=5.
Bounds a Ramsey number (of the hypercube), loosely related to the Ramsey numbers entry.
Euclidean Ramsey theory concerns monochromatic configurations under finite colorings of Euclidean space, related to colorings of unit-distance graphs.
Claims a proof of Seymour's second neighborhood conjecture.
Shows real circulant Hadamard matrices exist only in orders 1 and 4, settling the circulant version of Hadamard matrix existence.
Proves that every cubic bipartite 3-connected planar graph is Hamiltonian.
Improves the planar halving-line and k-set upper bound from O(n^{4/3}) to O(n^{4/3-eps}).
Determines exact Ramsey numbers R(C_m,K_n) for all m ≥ n ≥ 3, a family of off-diagonal Ramsey values.
Improves the Heilbronn triangle lower bound by a power, n^{-2+η}.
Proves strict positivity of Serre's intersection multiplicity over all regular local rings, including ramified mixed characteristic.
Serre's positivity is one of the homological conjectures in commutative algebra.
Lech's multiplicity conjecture is a local-ring multiplicity conjecture closely tied to the homological conjectures.
Disproves the small Cohen–Macaulay module conjecture, a central homological conjecture, in dimension 3.
Existence of (big/small) Cohen–Macaulay modules is the standard route to the monomial conjecture; the counterexample bears on that route.
Torsion-free group counterexample to Kaplansky's conjecture on zero divisors; related Kaplansky/surjunctivity circle of questions on group algebras.
Constructs injective non-surjective cellular automata on K^G, refuting Gottschalk's surjunctivity conjecture.
Gives a finitely presented nonsofic group (G is nonsofic since sofic groups are surjunctive/directly finite).
Disproves the little finitistic dimension conjecture, a homological conjecture for finite-dimensional algebras.
Counterexamples to Auslander–Reiten, Tachikawa, Nakayama and related homological conjectures for Artin algebras.
Eisenbud–Green–Harris concerns Hilbert functions of ideals containing regular sequences, closely related to Hilbert functions of forms.
Kurosh-type algebraicity problem for division rings, in the same circle of ring-theoretic nil/algebraic problems.
Alperin weight conjecture is a block-theoretic local-global counting conjecture closely related to Dade's conjecture.
Local-global counting conjecture in the same family as McKay; Alperin weight proof may bear on it.
Block theory finiteness conjecture (Donovan) in the same area as Dade's conjecture on blocks.
Saxl's conjecture concerns Kronecker coefficients (tensor squares of symmetric group irreps) being positive.
Exhibits a finite lattice that is not the congruence lattice of any finite algebra, answering the problem negatively.
Proves the Bass trace conjecture (Hattori–Stallings traces) for all discrete groups; possibly the Bass conjecture meant here is a different one, but a later look is warranted.
Constructs a massive continuum limit with a mass gap for the 2D O(3) sigma model, a toy analogue of the mass-gap question for asymptotically free gauge theories.
Proves the predicted 3/4 diameter exponent and 4/3 mass exponent for n-step self-avoiding walks on the honeycomb lattice.
Proves Shelah's eventual categoricity conjecture for AECs in ZFC.
Categoricity transfer above a threshold for AECs, closely related to the L_{omega_1,omega} Hanf-number form; also shows a CH obstruction to a prescribed Hanf-type threshold.
Descriptive-complexity result about whether a logic with counting captures polynomial time on unordered structures, a question adjacent to P vs NP.
Constructs an infinite finitely presented periodic group, answering the question negatively.
Finitely presented Burnside-type question, answered negatively with an infinite finitely presented periodic 2-group.
Finitely presented nil algebra over F_2 that is Jacobson radical but not nilpotent, bearing on nil-ring questions.
Constructs a group with cohomological dimension 2 and geometric dimension 3, disproving the conjecture.
Closely related to Eilenberg–Ganea and 2-dimensional aspherical complexes; worth a look.
Settles Zauner's dimension-six mutually unbiased bases conjecture (N(6)=3), a closely related quantum-design existence question to the SIC-POVM conjecture.
Proves a Fourier-vanishing conjecture for complex Hadamard matrices of order six, a loosely related Hadamard-matrix classification result.
Gives an exact (probability-one) polynomial-size quantum circuit family for complete integer factorization, a quantum-model variant of polynomial-time factoring.
Disproves the coefficient-free reduced Baum–Connes conjecture via failures of rational injectivity and of surjectivity of the assembly map.

Kirchberg's norm-ultrapower embedding question into O_2^ω concerns embeddability of full group C*-algebras into ultrapowers, closely related to Kirchberg's QWEP and Connes embedding circle of problems.
Constructs an operator with no nontrivial hyperinvariant subspace on separable Hilbert space, settling the hyperinvariant-subspace variant of the invariant subspace problem.
Microstates free entropy is built from matrix approximations of the kind that underlie Connes embeddability, so the family is worth a look.
Claims a proof of the Hilbert–Smith conjecture in every finite dimension for locally compact second-countable groups acting on manifolds.
Disproves the rational coarse Novikov conjecture, the coarse-geometry analogue of the Novikov conjecture, by showing coarse assembly is not rationally injective.
Concerns injectivity of (maximal and reduced) coarse assembly maps, the coarse Baum–Connes setting, with a counterexample to rational injectivity.
The Singer conjecture in dimension four concerns vanishing of L2-Betti numbers of aspherical manifolds and is closely tied to the Hopf conjectures on Euler characteristic sign.
Disproves a height-two finite-generation conjecture while examining comparisons between finite and telescopic localizations, adjacent to the telescope conjecture.
Builds homotopy equivalent but non-homeomorphic closed aspherical four-manifolds, disproving the homeomorphism-existence form of the Borel conjecture in dimension four.

Wall's D(2) problem is a close relative of the Eilenberg–Ganea question about 2-dimensional models for groups of cohomological dimension 2; the family gives a counterexample to the finite D(2) problem.
Proves the complete (matrix-valued) Crouzeix inequality with constant 2, which contains the scalar Crouzeix conjecture.
Concerns duality between convex bodies and their polars via covering numbers, a neighboring polar-body question to Mahler's volume-product conjecture.
Rational inessentiality under positive scalar curvature is in the same circle of ideas (aspherical manifolds, fundamental group, scalar curvature obstructions) as Novikov-type conjectures.
Proves that nonnegative-scalar-curvature metrics on closed aspherical manifolds are flat, a rigidity result about aspherical manifolds.
Proves the generalized Cartan–Hadamard isoperimetric inequality in every dimension, with Euclidean equality rigidity.
The nearby Lagrangian conjecture is a related Arnold-type conjecture in symplectic geometry about exact Lagrangians in cotangent bundles.

Constructs Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms with fewer nondegenerate fixed points than the stable Morse number, ordinary Morse number, critical number and cup length, disproving stronger forms of the Arnold conjecture.
Classifies nonnegatively and positively curved Einstein four-manifolds (S^2×S^2, CP^2, etc.), which bears on Hopf-type questions linking curvature sign and topology in dimension four.
Volume lower bound for minimal hypersurfaces of spheres, closely related to Yau's conjecture about minimal hypersurfaces in S^{n+1}.
Concerns closed minimal hypersurfaces in spheres and Clifford products, the examples at the heart of Chern-type gap conjectures.
Proves large-data global existence, uniqueness and smoothness for the 3D one-species relativistic Vlasov–Maxwell system, which is the global classical regularity problem.
Builds smooth forced 3D Navier–Stokes flows from rest that encode universal computation (halting detection), a computability result about the equations though not a regularity or blow-up result.
